what: Several cuts are stacked in a logo or picture slot with only one visible, and each press advances to the next cut, looping from the end back to the first (rapid presses advance as many cuts as were pressed) — like a running-horse logo that runs the more you press. With autoplay on, it advances every 100ms right after attaching and spins three loops, then slows by (1 + .65 × progress²) times toward the end and stops on the first cut

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Cuts (children) — two or more. Inline SVG, img, or text, all stacked in one cell
options.rapid: On rapid presses — queue (default, one per press) · throttle (presses within throttle ms are dropped) · frame (once per frame)
options.loop: If off, stops at the last cut
options.click: With off, it does not react to presses (automatic only)
options.autoplay: If on, it spins by itself as soon as it attaches (presses are ignored meanwhile) — the original part defaults to on, the Brand copy is off
options.reset: If off, it stays on the cut where the auto-spin ends (default returns to the first cut)
options.fx:frame · fx:end: Event fired from the element when the shot changes (detail.index) and when auto-rotation finishes

from.where: index.html Hero center 94px horse logo .b-mark — original code component Image Sequence Player (cuts in the zip · autoplay off · clickToAdvance · loopOnClick · rapidClickBehavior queue · throttle 120 · interval 100 · cycles 3 · endSlowdown .65)
